card.name: Digits inside numbers and names
card.fires_on: A single digit token inside a multi-digit number or numeric name, such as the 0 in 80beats, the 1 in 21st century, or the start of a phone number. It is mostly in general web text.

modes.label: Digit in a numeric name
modes.description: A digit within a name or title built on a number, such as 80beats, 20/20 or 300.

modes.description: A digit within a year, a date, a phone number or a section number.
